response.summary: The cartTotal function in src/cart.js adds up item.price without multiplying by item.quantity, causing the test assertion expecting item quantities to be factored in to fail.
response.rootCause: The logic in cartTotal accumulates item.price directly instead of multiplying item.price by item.quantity.

citations.note: The price is added without multiplying by the quantity.
The test expects the quantity to be factored in.

response.suggestedFix: Multiply the price by the quantity: sum += item.price * item.quantity;
